Fundamental Earth & Space Physics Principles

Coherent meteorological pulse-Doppler radar transmits microwave pulses that backscatter off raindrops or aerosol refractive index turbulence. Geological formations, atmospheric layers, and astrophysical systems behave according to conservation of momentum, gravitational potential theory, radiative energy transfer, and thermodynamics. The mathematical relationship governing the experimental telemetry observed during this investigation is expressed as:

Radial Velocity (m/s) = 2.4500 · Doppler Shift (kHz) + 5.0000
